# Content preservation

A mark whose content yields no text has nothing to index, but the content
itself must survive: deleting what the author wrote would be exactly the
silent corruption IP2 forbids.

An image with empty alt text, wrapped in a mark:
[![](dot.png)]{.index}

The same image with an explicit entry, which does index:
[![](dot.png)]{.index entry="Figure!Dot"}

A genuinely empty mark, which is dropped because there is nothing to show
and nothing to index:[]{.index}

# Cross-references with no source entry

A cross-reference needs an entry to hang off. Neither mark below has one, so
neither is indexed — and neither loses its content.

The image again, this time carrying a cross-reference:
[![](dot.png)]{.index see="Nowhere"}

An empty mark carrying a cross-reference, which is dropped like any other
empty mark:[]{.index see-also="Nowhere"}
